en-US.description: Next-generation AI Code Agent, empowering developers with efficient programming, automated code generation and intelligent optimization
en-US.longDescription: CarryCode is a terminal-native AI coding agent that helps you write, refactor, debug, and understand code — all through natural conversation. It connects to 17+ LLM providers(OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollma, vllm, GLM, KIMI, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Alibaba Claude etc), supports the MCP protocol for extensibility, supports the SKILL which is compatiable with claude code, supports AGENTS.md as project RULES, and delivers a beautiful terminal UI with themes, syntax highlighting, and code diff previews.
en-US.name: CarryCode

zh-CN.description: 下一代人工智能代码智能体，为开发者赋能，助力实现高效编程、自动化代码生成与智能优化
zh-CN.longDescription: CarryCode 是一款原生运行于终端的 AI 编程智能体，可通过自然对话帮你完成代码编写、重构、调试与理解工作。它可连接 17 家以上大语言模型服务商（包括 OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、OpenRouter、Ollama、vllm、智谱 GLM、月之暗面 KIMI、MiniMax、深度求索 DeepSeek、阿里通义千问 Claude 等），支持通过 MCP 协议实现功能扩展，兼容 Claude Code 的 SKILL 机制，支持将 AGENTS.md 作为项目规则文件，同时提供美观的终端界面，自带主题切换、语法高亮与代码差异预览功能。
